description: Flag names, numbers and dates that appear in an AI-generated summary but NOT in the source text it was based on — the usual shape of a hallucination. This is a lexical heuristic, not a fact-checker: it catches invented specifics, not wrong reasoning. Use it to decide what to verify by hand.

original.description: The source text the output was generated from.

name: check_output_fidelity
title: Check AI output against its source
